Add a DevKey and URL/Hostname here to ENABLE order confirmation scraping for individual merchants.

How to Add: In order to add to this toggle, we need to add the devkey to the deykey parameter, and also add 'devkey:domainname' to the domainDevKey parameter.

strategies.name: domainDevKey
strategies.description:
First add the devkey to the devkey section. And add the devkey and domian as a one:one mapping in the domainDevkey section. You can seperate them by a comma. Its a must to add the devkey to the devkey parameter for this feature toggle to work. 
Eg: testdevkey:bling.com
